description:
The Vilano Diverse 3.0 Performance Hybrid 24 speed bike is great for the commute, fitness or whatever the day’s ride brings! It features a hydroformed alloy aluminum frame and fork. Disc brakes provide plenty of control and stopping power in inclement weather. Includes water bottle mounts and platform pedals. While assembly of this factory direct bike is simple, it takes time and specialized tools. We highly recommend bringing it to a local shop for a safety check/tuning by a qualified bike mechanic prior to riding and at regular intervals thereafter.

The bike is shipped factory direct. Assembly & Tuning are Required. Pedal installation can be tricky, please follow included directions closely.

components.description: Triple 42/34/24T with replaceable chainrings, alloy crank arms
